description: Order animated pixel sprites of a character from one of the user's own still pictures (source_image_id from chargen_search_gallery). An order can have up to 10 portrait moves (preset or in the user's own words), the walk in 4 facings (walk_4_facings) or in 8 directions (walk_8_directions), and game moves in the facings the user picks (game_moves, at most 24 facings). It needs at least one move. Price: 10 Gold for each portrait or typed move, 48 Gold for the walk in 4 facings (12 for each facing), 80 Gold for the walk in 8 directions (10 for each facing), and 25 Gold for each facing of a game move. All moves of one picture and style are drawn from one base sprite, so they match. While the first order for a picture and style still draws that base, a new order for it fails and charges nothing; order again when the first is done. These are animated moves; for one still sprite sheet image, use chargen_run_recipe_rpg_sprite_sheet. First call chargen_quote_character_sprites, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Returns request_id; poll chargen_get_job for each move's animated GIF. A move that fails is refunded. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

actions.description: Preset portrait moves, each one at most once, 10 Gold each. actions and custom_actions together hold at most 10 moves. An order needs at least one move from actions, custom_actions, walk_4_facings, walk_8_directions or game_moves.

custom_actions.description: Moves in the user's own words, for example "raises a glass in a toast".

details.description: Optional details the picture does not show, for example "a captain's rapier".

game_moves.description: Game moves, each move at most once, 25 Gold for each facing. At most 24 facings in all. A facing that fails is refunded 25. For a walk, walk_4_facings costs less than the walk game move in the same 4 facings.

facings.description: The facings to make this move in, each one at most once. S faces the viewer (down the screen), N faces away (up the screen), E faces right and W faces left; SE, NE, NW and SW are between them.

move.description: The game move. idle, walk, run and sprint loop; the others play one time, and death stops on its last frame.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_character_sprites. Use the same inputs; changed inputs or prices fail without charging.

source_image_id.description: UUID of one of the user's own still pictures, from chargen_search_gallery. The character is drawn from it.

style.description: FINE (the default) draws more detail and adds HD files. CHUNKY draws bigger, simpler pixels. Each style of a picture has its own base sprite.

title.description: Optional name for these sprites in the user's library.

walk_4_facings.description: true adds a looping walk in 4 facings, S, E, N and W: 48 Gold (12 for each facing), cut from the same video as the walk in 8 directions. A facing that fails is refunded 12. Give walk_4_facings or walk_8_directions, not both.

walk_8_directions.description: true adds a looping walk in all 8 facings, 80 Gold (10 for each facing). A facing that fails is refunded 10. Give walk_4_facings or walk_8_directions, not both.

name: chargen_generate_character_sprites
title: Order character sprites
